title: Typo in README file for requirements file name
body:
There is a typo in the README file:  

Current:  
```
# Install requirements  
pip install -r requirement.txt  
```

Expected:  
```
# Install requirements  
pip install -r requirements.txt  
```

Suggestion: Please rename `requirement.txt` to `requirements.txt` to follow common naming conventions.
author: jamiu99

comments.body: Thank you, we have fixed this issue.

title: M
body:
This is a modified version of the official code.  
1. Articles are generated starting from leaf section nodes. Non-leaf section nodes are generated by summarizing leaf section nodes. Then the leaf section node will be removed. The generated article will retain the outline structure except leaf section node.  
2. Using SearXNG search engine and deepseek-v3 model.
author: techshoww

comments.body: Hi, thank you very much for your contribution to OmniThink. Since your PR modified the prompt, it would affect the reproducibility of the final results, so we had to reject your PR. However, we have manually integrated your SearXNG API into the code, and we really appreciate your contributions to OmniThink.

title: Docker support please
body: Can we please add docker support... thanks!
author: arsaboo

comments.body: Thank you very much for your attention. We will be adding Docker in the near future.
Hi, thank you very much for your attention. We have added Docker support, and we welcome you to use it.
@XeeKee I did not see any docker compose or any instructions in the readme. Could you please update the same...thanks!

Sorry for the inconvenience. I recently updated our Docker but didn't upload it to the cloud drive; instead, I placed it in the Docker repository. We also updated the README with usage instructions. You're welcome to give it a try!
Since I don't use Docker frequently, there may be some oversights. If you still encounter any issues, feel free to reopen this issue and generously share your questions.
